description: This Scala source file defines the YarnAllocatorNodeHealthTracker class, which manages node health status and exclusion lists for YARN resource management within Apache Spark's YARN deployment. It tracks node failures, updates YARN's blacklist, and ensures efficient resource allocation by excluding problematic nodes.

classes.name: YarnAllocatorNodeHealthTracker
classes.description: A class responsible for tracking node health and managing node exclusion lists in YARN for Spark.

methods.name: setNumClusterNodes
methods.description: Sets the total number of nodes in the cluster.

methods.name: handleResourceAllocationFailure
methods.description: Handles resource allocation failures, potentially excluding nodes based on failure counts.

methods.name: updateAllocationExcludedNodes
methods.description: Updates the list of nodes excluded due to failures and refreshes the YARN blacklist.

methods.name: setSchedulerExcludedNodes
methods.description: Sets nodes excluded by the scheduler with expiry times.

methods.name: isAllNodeExcluded
methods.description: Checks if all cluster nodes are excluded.

methods.name: refreshExcludedNodes
methods.description: Refreshes the list of excluded nodes, removing expired entries and synchronizing with YARN.

methods.name: synchronizeExcludedNodesWithYarn
methods.description: Updates YARN's blacklist with current excluded nodes.

methods.name: removeExpiredYarnExcludedNodes
methods.description: Removes nodes from the exclusion list that have expired.
